name: A World Made For Us
source: They met last year. A boy and a girl are continuing their journey as friends. Suddenly, something kicks in their hearts as they realize their feelings for each other. This story will focus on the slow-burn intensity and teen romance.
translation: 他们去年认识的。一个男孩和一个女孩作为朋友继续他们的旅程。突然，当他们意识到彼此的感情时，有什么东西在他们的心中激荡。这个故事将重点关注缓慢燃烧的强度和青少年的浪漫。
